items.title: Dysfunction of the blood-brain barrier and neurovascular unit in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis - From advanced human models to treatments.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons, resulting in progressive and eventually complete loss of motor function. The phenotypical heterogeneity of ALS poses a challenge to early diagnosis and treatment, with currently available therapeutics only capable of relieving symptoms and slowing progression. While ALS is classified as a motor neuron disease (MND), research has identified significant impairment to the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and neurovascular unit (NVU) of ALS patients. The BBB along with supporting cells of the NVU selectively control the entry of substances into the central nervous system (CNS) and maintain brain homeostasis, with its many cellular components demonstrating impaired function, specifically relating to inflammation, oxidative stress and TDP-43 proteinopathy. The advent of more advanced in vitro techniques as well as use of patient-derived BBB cells has presented a promising alternative to recreate the in vivo structure of the BBB/NVU in a highly controlled platform. Such approaches have ranged from simple 2-dimensional (2D) cell culture to intricate 3-dimensional (3D) co-culture systems, as well as microfluidic systems and organoids, with a potential to investigate ALS associated BBB/NVU dysfunction and drug discovery. This review provides a comprehensive assessment of known BBB/NVU dysfunction in ALS and methods of investigating this using in vitro and in vivo platforms with a focus on inflammation, oxidative stress and pathological TDP-43 expression. This review also presents a future perspective to overcoming barriers to treatment of ALS using new patient-derived BBB/NVU model systems.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中血脑屏障与神经血管单元的功能障碍——从先进人类模型到治疗
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS中血脑屏障和神经血管单元的功能障碍，涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变等机制。文章重点介绍了从2D培养到3D共培养、微流控和类器官等先进体外模型，以及患者来源BBB细胞在模拟ALS病理和药物筛选中的应用潜力。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS的病理视野从运动神经元扩展到血脑屏障和神经血管单元，并系统盘点了患者来源的先进体外模型。对于关注ALS非神经元病理机制、药物递送障碍以及人源化模型转化的研究者，这篇综述提供了整合性的框架和未来方向。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS中存在血脑屏障和神经血管单元功能障碍，与炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变相关；患者来源的2D、3D、微流控和类器官模型可用于研究这些机制并助力药物发现。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据；所讨论的体外模型仍处于发展阶段，其能否完全再现体内BBB/NVU结构和ALS病理仍有待验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元变性为特征，导致运动功能进行性且最终完全丧失。ALS的表型异质性给早期诊断和治疗带来挑战，目前可用的治疗手段仅能缓解症状并延缓进展。尽管ALS被归类为运动神经元病（MND），但研究已发现ALS患者的血脑屏障（BBB）和神经血管单元（NVU）存在显著损伤。BBB与NVU的支持细胞选择性控制物质进入中枢神经系统（CNS）并维持脑内稳态，其多种细胞组分表现出功能受损，尤其与炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变相关。更先进的体外技术以及患者来源BBB细胞的应用，为在高度可控平台上重建BBB/NVU的体内结构提供了有前景的替代方案。此类方法从简单的二维（2D）细胞培养到复杂的三维（3D）共培养系统，以及微流控系统和类器官，具有研究ALS相关BBB/NVU功能障碍和药物发现的潜力。本综述全面评估了ALS中已知的BBB/NVU功能障碍，以及利用体外和体内平台研究这一问题的方法，重点关注炎症、氧化应激和病理性TDP-43表达。本综述还提出了利用新的患者来源BBB/NVU模型系统克服ALS治疗障碍的未来展望。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦ALS中血脑屏障/神经血管单元功能障碍这一新近受到关注的非神经元病理维度，并强调患者来源先进体外模型的转化价值。

items.title: Microbiota-derived metabolite-GPCR signalling in neurodegeneration.
items.summary: The gut microbiome acts as a primary regulator of host homeostasis, influencing the entire body through bidirectional communication along the gut-brain axis (GBA). Dysbiosis, which is defined as a state of microbial imbalance involving alterations in community composition and function, can disrupt the synthesis of important microbiota-derived metabolites, such as short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), bile acids and neurotransmitter precursors. This can lead to impaired essential host signalling pathways. There is growing evidence that metabolic alterations associated with dysbiosis contribute to the onset and progression of neurodegenerative disorders (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), Huntington's disease (HD), multiple sclerosis (MS) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). In this context, G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) act as essential molecular transducers that link microbial metabolites to intracellular signalling networks. Aberrant GPCR activation, driven by altered metabolite profiles, modulates key downstream pathways including cAMP, MAPK, PI3K/Akt, NF-κB and Ca2 + signalling. This promotes neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction and pathological protein aggregation - hallmark processes underlying neurodegeneration. By identifying convergent and disease-specific signalling pathways, the review highlights mechanistic nodes of therapeutic relevance and discusses GPCR-centric emerging and other microbiome-targeted strategies aimed at restoring metabolic and signalling homeostasis in neurodegenerative disorders.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中微生物群衍生代谢物-GPCR信号传导
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了肠道菌群失调如何通过改变短链脂肪酸、胆汁酸和神经递质前体等代谢物，进而影响G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）信号，最终参与阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病、多发性硬化及肌萎缩侧索硬化等神经退行性疾病的发病机制。文章重点讨论了cAMP、MAPK、PI3K/Akt、NF-κB和钙信号等下游通路，以及它们如何驱动神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和蛋白聚集。作者还总结了以GPCR为靶点、旨在恢复代谢与信号稳态的潜在干预策略。
items.insight: 该综述将微生物代谢物-GPCR信号轴置于多种神经退行性疾病的共同机制框架中，对ALS研究者有两点参考价值：一是提示肠道菌群失调可能通过GPCR影响神经炎症、线粒体功能和蛋白稳态等ALS核心病理过程；二是梳理了可干预的GPCR节点及微生物组靶向策略，为ALS中肠-脑轴机制研究和治疗靶点发现提供了可检验的假说。但需注意，本文为综述，所提机制和策略多基于临床前或关联性证据，尚不能视为ALS临床疗效已确立。

aiRead.keyFinding: 菌群失调导致的微生物代谢物改变可通过GPCR信号影响cAMP、MAPK、PI3K/Akt、NF-κB和钙信号等通路，促进神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和蛋白聚集，从而参与ALS等神经退行性疾病。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为综述，未提供原始临床或实验数据；所讨论的机制和干预策略多基于临床前或关联性证据，不能直接推断ALS临床疗效。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对特定微生物代谢物-GPCR轴在ALS模型中的功能验证，以及以GPCR为靶点的微生物组干预策略是否进入临床转化研究。

items.abstractZh: 肠道微生物组是宿主稳态的主要调节者，通过肠-脑轴（GBA）的双向通讯影响全身。菌群失调被定义为涉及群落组成和功能改变的微生物失衡状态，可破坏重要微生物群衍生代谢物的合成，如短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）、胆汁酸和神经递质前体。这可能导致宿主必需信号通路受损。越来越多的证据表明，与菌群失调相关的代谢改变促进了神经退行性疾病（NDDs）的发生和进展，包括阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、亨廷顿病（HD）、多发性硬化（MS）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）。在此背景下，G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）作为关键分子转导器，将微生物代谢物与细胞内信号网络连接起来。由代谢物谱改变驱动的异常GPCR激活，调节关键下游通路，包括cAMP、MAPK、PI3K/Akt、NF-κB和Ca2+信号传导。这促进了神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和病理性蛋白聚集——这些是神经退行性变的标志性过程。通过识别趋同和疾病特异性信号通路，该综述强调了具有治疗相关性的机制节点，并讨论了以GPCR为中心的新兴策略及其他微生物组靶向策略，旨在恢复神经退行性疾病中的代谢和信号稳态。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了微生物群衍生代谢物通过GPCR信号参与ALS等神经退行性疾病的机制证据，并指出以GPCR为中心的微生物组靶向策略具有转化潜力。

items.title: The thymus gland is a target and maintainer of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathophysiology.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by the selective loss of motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord with evidence of local neuroinflammation. Regulatory T cells (Treg) exert neuroprotective effects and correlate with disease progression, but central mechanisms governing Treg development during ALS remain unclear. We investigated the thymic architecture and T cell differentiation in SOD1-G93A (mSOD1) ALS mice at multiple disease stages. Thymocyte and thymic epithelial cells (TEC) subpopulations, as well as stages of Treg differentiation and suppressive capacity, were analyzed by flow cytometry, in situ immunofluorescence, and functional assays. At late disease stage (120 days-old), mSOD1 mice displayed thymic atrophy, reduced thymocyte numbers, and decreased double-positive (DP), CD4 single-positive (SP), and Treg populations. Foxp3 expression per cell was preserved, but Treg progenitors and mature Treg numbers declined, paralleled by reduced suppressive function in vitro . TEC analysis revealed reduced total and mature medullary TEC (CD80 high MHCII high ), despite preserved Aire expression. Foxp3 + cells were abnormally localized at cortical sites, away from mTEC, associated with migratory abnormalities and increased apoptosis. TREC evaluation revealed reduced intrathymic sjTREC, consistent with impaired proliferation and differentiation between DN and DP stages, although peripheral sj/βTREC ratios remained stable. Reduced Treg numbers were also observed in lymph nodes draining affected hindlimbs. Our findings identify the thymus as a target organ in ALS, where thymic involution, TEC loss, and Treg dysfunction may compromise immune tolerance. These alterations likely reinforce the role of the thymus in peripheral immune dysregulation and neuroinflammation observed in ALS.
items.titleZh: 胸腺是肌萎缩侧索硬化病理生理学的靶标和维持者
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型中发现，疾病晚期胸腺出现萎缩、胸腺上皮细胞丢失和Treg发育及功能受损，提示胸腺可能是ALS免疫失调的重要环节。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS的免疫机制从外周Treg功能异常上溯至胸腺中枢耐受缺陷，为理解神经炎症的持续来源提供了新的组织学靶点；若能在人类ALS中验证胸腺退化与Treg耗竭的关联，可能为免疫调节治疗提供更早的干预窗口。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，其特征是脑和脊髓中运动神经元的选择性丢失，并伴有局部神经炎症的证据。调节性T细胞（Treg）发挥神经保护作用并与疾病进展相关，但ALS期间调控Treg发育的中枢机制仍不清楚。我们在多个疾病阶段研究了SOD1-G93A（mSOD1）ALS小鼠的胸腺结构和T细胞分化。通过流式细胞术、原位免疫荧光和功能测定，分析了胸腺细胞和胸腺上皮细胞（TEC）亚群，以及Treg分化和抑制能力的各个阶段。在疾病晚期（120日龄），mSOD1小鼠表现出胸腺萎缩、胸腺细胞数量减少，以及双阳性（DP）、CD4单阳性（SP）和Treg群体减少。每个细胞的Foxp3表达得以保留，但Treg祖细胞和成熟Treg数量下降，同时体外抑制功能降低。TEC分析显示总TEC和成熟髓质TEC（CD80高MHCII高）减少，尽管Aire表达得以保留。Foxp3+细胞异常定位于皮质部位，远离mTEC，与迁移异常和凋亡增加相关。TREC评估显示胸腺内sjTREC减少，与DN和DP阶段之间的增殖和分化受损一致，尽管外周sj/βTREC比值保持稳定。在引流受累后肢的淋巴结中也观察到Treg数量减少。我们的发现确定胸腺是ALS的靶器官，其中胸腺退化、TEC丢失和Treg功能障碍可能损害免疫耐受。这些改变可能强化了胸腺在ALS中观察到的外周免疫失调和神经炎症中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了胸腺作为ALS免疫失调的中枢靶器官，将Treg功能障碍与胸腺退化直接关联，具有明确的转化研究价值。

items.title: Exploring the toxicological impact of BDE-209 on neurodegenerative diseases through network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and in-vitro study.
items.summary: Decabromodiphenyl ether (BDE-209) is a persistent flame retardant associated with neurotoxicity, but its potential links to neurodegenerative diseases remain unclear. We integrated network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and in vitro experiments to investigate BDE-209 in Parkinson's disease (PD), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Network analysis identified 90 shared targets, enriched in lipid metabolism, oxidative stress, and inflammatory pathways, including IL-17 and TNF signaling. Docking prioritized the FKBP12-mTOR complex as a candidate binding system, with a score of -8.6 kcal/mol. MD simulations supported the stability of the predicted pose, which was dominated by van der Waals and hydrophobic interactions involving PHE-128 and TRP-190. In differentiated PC12 cells, BDE-209 increased p-mTOR at 10 μM and IL-1β at 20 μM without overt cytotoxicity. Rapamycin attenuated the p-mTOR response, supporting mTOR involvement, although mTOR dependence of IL-1β induction was not established. At 40 μM, BDE-209 reduced viability, potentially confounded by precipitation or aggregation. These findings implicate mTOR dysregulation in BDE-209 cellular responses, but direct binding, chronic exposure, and in vivo disease relevance require further validation.
items.titleZh: 通过网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和体外研究探索BDE-209对神经退行性疾病的毒理学影响
items.summaryZh: 该研究结合网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和PC12细胞实验，探讨持久性阻燃剂BDE-209与帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化的潜在关联。分析发现90个共享靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路；分子对接提示FKBP12-mTOR复合物为候选结合系统。细胞实验中，BDE-209在10 μM增加p-mTOR、20 μM增加IL-1β，雷帕霉素可减弱p-mTOR反应，但IL-1β诱导是否依赖mTOR尚未确定；40 μM时细胞活力下降，可能存在沉淀或聚集干扰。研究提示mTOR失调可能参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性仍需验证。
items.insight: 该研究将环境毒理学与ALS等神经退行性疾病机制联系起来，提出BDE-209可能通过mTOR信号通路和炎症相关靶点影响神经退行性过程。虽然目前仅为体外细胞和计算模拟证据，但mTOR失调是ALS研究中受到关注的通路之一，且环境暴露因素在ALS病因学中仍属相对未被充分探索的领域。研究者可关注其共享靶点网络和FKBP12-mTOR相互作用假说是否能在后续体内模型或患者样本中得到验证。

items.abstractZh: 十溴二苯醚（BDE-209）是一种与神经毒性相关的持久性阻燃剂，但其与神经退行性疾病的潜在联系仍不清楚。我们整合了网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟和体外实验，研究BDE-209在帕金森病（PD）、阿尔茨海默病（AD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的作用。网络分析识别出90个共享靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路，包括IL-17和TNF信号通路。对接分析将FKBP12-mTOR复合物列为候选结合系统，评分为-8.6 kcal/mol。MD模拟支持预测构象的稳定性，该构象主要由涉及PHE-128和TRP-190的范德华力和疏水相互作用主导。在分化的PC12细胞中，BDE-209在10 μM时增加p-mTOR，在20 μM时增加IL-1β，且无明显细胞毒性。雷帕霉素减弱了p-mTOR反应，支持mTOR参与其中，但IL-1β诱导对mTOR的依赖性尚未确立。在40 μM时，BDE-209降低细胞活力，可能受到沉淀或聚集的混杂影响。这些发现提示mTOR失调参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性仍需进一步验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近整合网络毒理学与体外实验，提示环境污染物BDE-209可能通过mTOR通路与ALS等神经退行性疾病产生关联，具有环境暴露与ALS机制交叉的转化探索价值。

items.title: Associations Between Prediagnosis Plasma Neurofilament Light Polypeptide and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Risk in the Danish EPIC Cohort.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease with a rapid time from symptoms onset to diagnosis. Elevated neurofilament light polypeptide (NfL) is well-established in symptomatic ALS and up to 5 years prediagnosis, but earlier timeframes remain understudied. We aimed to assess plasma NfL levels up to 23 years before ALS diagnosis and the relation to ALS risk. We conducted a nested matched case-control study within the Danish EPIC cohort (baseline 1993-1997) including 166 ALS cases (diagnosed 1997-2017) and 332 controls matched on birth year and sex. Plasma samples collected 0.4 to 23.2 years (median 14.1 years) prediagnosis were analyzed for NfL using Olink Target 96. Odds ratios were estimated using conditional logistic regression. Discriminatory performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic curves. NfL levels were elevated in ALS cases relative to controls up to 14.6 years before diagnosis. Among those with blood samples collected <5, 5 to 14.6, and >14.6 years before diagnosis, the odds ratios (95% CI) for ALS per standard deviation increase in the normalized protein expression value of NfL were 3.8 (1.4-10.3), 1.7 (1.2-2.3), and 1.3 (0.9-1.7), respectively. The areas under the curve for ALS discrimination by NfL among those with blood collected <5 and 5-14.6 years before diagnosis were 0.78 and 0.63, respectively. Plasma NfL elevation may occur significantly earlier than previously reported, indicating a much longer ALS prodrome. Assuming other biomarker changes may also occur earlier, this raises the possibility of identifying at-risk individuals early that could benefit epidemiologic analyses, clinical trials, and prevention efforts. items.summaryZh: 这项基于丹麦EPIC队列的巢式病例对照研究显示，ALS患者诊断前血浆NfL水平升高可早至诊断前14.6年，且距诊断越近，关联越强、判别能力越好。这提示ALS前驱期可能远长于既往认识，为极早期识别高危人群提供了线索。
items.insight: 该研究将ALS诊断前NfL升高的可检测时间窗从既往约5年大幅提前至14.6年，提示ALS前驱期可能长达十余年。对ALS研究者而言，这既支持将NfL用于极早期风险分层和临床试验入组富集，也提示需要重新审视前驱期生物标志物动态、试验设计的时间窗选择以及预防性干预的可行性。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，从症状出现到诊断的时间很短。神经丝轻链多肽（NfL）升高在症状性ALS及诊断前长达5年内已得到充分证实，但更早的时间窗仍研究不足。我们旨在评估ALS诊断前长达23年的血浆NfL水平及其与ALS风险的关系。我们在丹麦EPIC队列（基线1993-1997年）内开展了一项巢式匹配病例对照研究，纳入166例ALS病例（1997-2017年诊断）和332例按出生年份和性别匹配的对照。采用Olink Target 96分析诊断前0.4至23.2年（中位数14.1年）采集的血浆样本中的NfL。使用条件logistic回归估计比值比。采用受试者工作特征曲线评估判别性能。在诊断前长达14.6年，ALS病例的NfL水平相对于对照升高。在诊断前<5年、5至14.6年及>14.6年采集血样的受试者中，NfL归一化蛋白表达值每增加一个标准差，ALS的比值比（95% CI）分别为3.8（1.4-10.3）、1.7（1.2-2.3）和1.3（0.9-1.7）。在诊断前<5年和5-14.6年采集血液的受试者中，NfL判别ALS的曲线下面积分别为0.78和0.63。血浆NfL升高可能显著早于既往报道，提示ALS前驱期远更长。假设其他生物标志物变化也可能更早出现，这提高了早期识别高危个体的可能性，从而可能使流行病学分析、临床试验和预防工作受益。ANN NEUROL 2026。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近将ALS诊断前血浆NfL升高的可检测窗口扩展至14.6年，对ALS极早期生物标志物识别和临床试验前驱期入组策略具有重要转化价值。

items.title: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: This article describes the nerve loss underlying amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, its clinical manifestations, examination findings leading to the diagnosis, the expanding role of genetics, and available treatment and patient management. The cause of neuron death in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis is not known, but many genes are strongly linked to the disease, in both patients with a family history and those with no history. A multistep pathologic process helps to explain the onset of symptoms later in life, even in patients with associated genes. Posttranslational and epigenetic changes are also important factors. Current clinical trials are based on putative pathologic mechanisms, and some newer therapies are gene-based. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis has distinctive features and can be diagnosed largely from the history and examination, and true mimics are rare. While the cause of neuronal death is not known, pathogenic and risk factor gene variations are present in a number of patients, and posttranscriptional and epigenetic changes are likely major causative factors. Environmental factors likely contribute, but specific avoidable factors have not been identified. Drugs to slow the progress of the disease are currently limited, but trials for all patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis continue, including a focus on genetic factors. Patient management is optimized in multidisciplinary amyotrophic lateral sclerosis clinics, and interventions for nutrition with gastric feeding tubes and respiratory insufficiency by noninvasive ventilation enhance patient comfort.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇关于肌萎缩侧索硬化的综述，系统梳理了该病的神经退行性基础、临床表现与诊断路径、遗传学作用、可能的病理机制以及当前治疗和患者管理策略。文章强调ALS神经元死亡原因仍不明确，但遗传因素、翻译后修饰和表观遗传改变被认为是重要机制；当前药物只能有限延缓进展，多学科综合管理（包括营养支持和无创通气）是优化患者照护的关键。
items.insight: 该综述来自权威继续教育期刊，适合作为ALS研究者快速更新知识框架的参考。它明确区分了已知与未知：遗传学在家族性和散发性ALS中均有重要作用，多步骤病理模型可解释晚年发病，而表观遗传和翻译后改变可能是核心机制。对研究者而言，其价值在于帮助定位当前临床试验所依据的机制假设，并提示基因为基础的治疗是前沿方向，同时强调多学科管理仍是现阶段患者照护的基石。

items.abstractZh: 本文描述了肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）背后的神经丢失、其临床表现、导致诊断的检查发现、遗传学日益扩大的作用，以及现有的治疗和患者管理。ALS患者神经元死亡的原因尚不清楚，但许多基因与该病密切相关，无论患者有无家族史。多步骤病理过程有助于解释症状为何在晚年才出现，即使在携带相关基因的患者中也是如此。翻译后修饰和表观遗传改变也是重要因素。当前临床试验基于推测的病理机制，一些较新的疗法基于基因。ALS具有独特特征，主要可通过病史和检查作出诊断，真正的模拟病罕见。虽然神经元死亡的原因尚不清楚，但致病性和风险因素基因变异存在于部分患者中，转录后和表观遗传改变可能是主要致病因素。环境因素可能起作用，但尚未确定具体的可避免因素。目前减缓疾病进展的药物有限，但针对所有ALS患者的试验仍在继续，包括对遗传因素的关注。在多学科ALS门诊中患者管理得到优化，通过胃造瘘管进行营养干预和通过无创通气处理呼吸功能不全可提高患者舒适度。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，系统整合了ALS遗传学、表观遗传机制及基因为基础疗法等新近进展，对理解当前ALS临床试验的机制基础和转化方向具有参考价值。

items.title: Insertion or deletion variants in TAF15 exon 15 are genetic factors impacting the prognosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in a Japanese cohort.
items.summary: The influence of genetic factors on the prognosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) has attracted considerable attention, with numerous studies exploring this relationship in clinically diagnosed patients. The present study attempted to clarify the precise impact of genetic factors on prognosis in patients with pathologically confirmed sporadic ALS. We conducted exome analysis on 137 consecutively autopsied patients with sporadic ALS exhibiting TDP-43 pathology, screening for non-synonymous or splice-site rare variants (RVs) in ALS-related genes. The impact of these variants on ALS prognosis was subsequently assessed. The exome analysis identified 31 RVs in 27 of the 137 patients, including TAF15 exon 15 insertion/deletion mutations (TAF15-15 indels) in 9 patients. Patients harboring RVs had significantly shorter survival times (median 18.0 months) than those without RVs (28.5 months), as determined by log-rank test (p = 0.02). Notably, the 9 cases with TAF15-15 indels demonstrated a significantly poorer outcome (15.0 months, p = 3e-06). Lattice Simulation of Sticker-Spacer Interactions (LASSI) simulations revealed stronger negative sticker-sticker interactions, and a tendency toward lower saturation concentration and higher dense-phase concentration in TAF15-15 indel proteins, suggesting enhanced condensation. The present analysis of pathologically diagnosed ALS patients has yielded genetic factors that could potentially aid more accurate diagnosis and prognostication. The frequent identification of TAF15-15 indels among ALS cases, and their association with significantly poorer outcome, suggests that this type of mutation could be prognostically significant in ALS. Furthermore, the mechanism by which TAF15-15 indels influence the course of ALS could be a promising target for future treatments.
items.titleZh: TAF15第15外显子插入或缺失变异是影响日本队列肌萎缩侧索硬化预后的遗传因素
items.summaryZh: 这项研究对137例经尸检病理确诊的散发性ALS患者进行了外显子组分析，发现携带罕见变异的患者生存期更短，其中9例携带TAF15第15外显子插入/缺失突变的患者预后尤其差（中位生存15.0个月）。计算模拟提示该突变可能增强TAF15蛋白的凝聚倾向。研究提示TAF15-15 indels可能是ALS预后标志物和潜在治疗靶点。
items.insight: 该研究首次在病理确诊的ALS队列中系统评估了TAF15第15外显子插入/缺失变异与预后的关联，并提供了蛋白凝聚增强的机制线索。TAF15作为RNA结合蛋白，与TDP-43病理相关，其突变可能影响应激颗粒动态或蛋白稳态。这一发现值得ALS研究者跟踪，因为它可能拓展对ALS遗传异质性的理解，并为预后分层和靶向干预提供新方向。

items.abstractZh: 遗传因素对肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）预后的影响已引起广泛关注，众多研究在临床诊断患者中探索了这一关系。本研究试图阐明遗传因素对经病理确诊的散发性ALS患者预后的确切影响。我们对137例连续尸检的、具有TDP-43病理表现的散发性ALS患者进行了外显子组分析，筛查ALS相关基因中的非同义或剪接位点罕见变异（RVs）。随后评估了这些变异对ALS预后的影响。外显子组分析在137例患者中的27例中发现了31个RVs，包括9例患者中的TAF15第15外显子插入/缺失突变（TAF15-15 indels）。携带RVs的患者生存时间（中位18.0个月）显著短于无RVs的患者（28.5个月），经log-rank检验确定（p = 0.02）。值得注意的是，9例携带TAF15-15 indels的病例表现出显著更差的结局（15.0个月，p = 3e-06）。贴纸-间隔区相互作用的晶格模拟（LASSI）显示，TAF15-15 indel蛋白中贴纸-贴纸负相互作用更强，并倾向于更低的饱和浓度和更高的浓相浓度，提示凝聚增强。本项对病理确诊ALS患者的分析发现了可能有助于更准确诊断和预后判断的遗传因素。TAF15-15 indels在ALS病例中的频繁发现及其与显著更差结局的关联，提示此类突变可能在ALS中具有预后意义。此外，TAF15-15 indels影响ALS病程的机制可能成为未来治疗的有前景的靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于病理确诊的ALS队列，新近揭示了TAF15第15外显子插入/缺失变异与不良预后的显著关联，并提示蛋白凝聚机制，具有预后标志物和转化治疗价值。

items.title: Progressive anterior opercular syndrome (Foix-Chavany-Marie syndrome) in neurodegenerative disease: a case series.
items.summary: Anterior opercular syndrome (Foix-Chavany-Marie syndrome) is characterized by severe dysarthria, impaired voluntary orofacial and pharyngolingual movements, and preserved automatic or emotional movements (automatic-voluntary dissociation). Although classically associated with stroke, its progressive neurodegenerative form is rare and poorly understood. We report two patients to characterize its clinical and neuroanatomical features. The cases were identified retrospectively through review of clinical and neuroimaging records from behavioral neurology centers in the United States and Japan. Both had severe dysarthria and oral-phase dysphagia. Voluntary orofacial movements were markedly impaired, whereas reflexive movements, including coughing and yawning, and emotional movements, including smiling in response to humor, were preserved. Coordination, posture, and gait were initially preserved. Both patients showed predominantly upper motor neuron features without lower motor neuron signs; limb and cranial electromyography was normal in the patient tested. Neuroimaging showed bilateral frontal atrophy and hypometabolism or hypoperfusion involving the anterior operculum. These findings suggest that progressive anterior opercular syndrome may emerge when bilateral opercular regions are affected by neurodegeneration. Recognition of this syndrome may facilitate anticipatory management of dysarthria, dysphagia, and nutritional risk and broaden awareness of speech and orofacial motor syndromes in frontotemporal dementia and related phenotypes.

items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中的进行性前岛盖综合征（Foix-Chavany-Marie综合征）：病例系列
items.summaryZh: 这项病例系列报告了两例以进行性构音障碍和口腔期吞咽困难为主要表现的患者，其自主口面部运动严重受损，但咳嗽、打哈欠及情绪性微笑等自动或情绪性运动保留，符合前岛盖综合征的自动-自主分离特征。影像学显示双侧额叶萎缩及前岛盖代谢或灌注减低，提示神经退行性变可导致进行性前岛盖综合征。该综合征与额颞叶痴呆及相关表型有关，识别它有助于提前管理构音障碍、吞咽困难和营养风险。
items.insight: 该病例系列提示，进行性前岛盖综合征可作为神经退行性疾病（尤其是额颞叶痴呆及相关表型）的一种口面部运动综合征出现，其自动-自主分离和双侧前岛盖受累的神经解剖基础值得ALS研究者关注，因为ALS也常累及延髓/假性延髓功能，且需与额颞叶痴呆谱系重叠。识别这一综合征有助于在ALS及相关疾病中更早识别构音障碍、吞咽困难和营养风险，并推动对延髓运动综合征的鉴别诊断。

aiRead.keyFinding: 两例神经退行性疾病患者表现为进行性前岛盖综合征，具有严重构音障碍、口腔期吞咽困难、自主口面部运动受损而自动/情绪性运动保留，影像显示双侧额叶萎缩及前岛盖代谢或灌注减低。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量极小（仅2例），为回顾性研究，无对照组，无法确定患病率、自然史或因果关系；肌电图仅在一例患者中完成。
aiRead.watchNext: 需在更大规模的前瞻性队列中验证该综合征在额颞叶痴呆及相关神经退行性疾病（包括ALS谱系）中的频率、演变轨迹及对吞咽和营养管理的影响。

items.abstractZh: 前岛盖综合征（Foix-Chavany-Marie综合征）以严重构音障碍、自主口面部及咽舌运动受损、而自动性或情绪性运动保留（自动-自主分离）为特征。尽管该综合征经典上与卒中相关，但其进行性神经退行性变形式罕见且认识不足。我们报告两例患者以描述其临床和神经解剖学特征。病例通过回顾美国及日本行为神经病学中心的临床和神经影像记录进行回顾性识别。两例患者均有严重构音障碍和口腔期吞咽困难。自主口面部运动明显受损，而反射性运动（包括咳嗽和打哈欠）及情绪性运动（包括对幽默发笑）保留。协调、姿势和步态最初保留。两例患者均表现为以上运动神经元特征为主，无下运动神经元体征；接受检测的患者四肢和颅神经肌电图正常。神经影像显示双侧额叶萎缩及累及前岛盖的代谢减低或灌注减低。这些发现提示，当双侧岛盖区域受到神经退行性变影响时，可能出现进行性前岛盖综合征。识别该综合征可能有助于对构音障碍、吞咽困难和营养风险进行预判性管理，并拓宽对额颞叶痴呆及相关表型中言语和口面部运动综合征的认识。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近描述了神经退行性变所致进行性前岛盖综合征的临床-影像特征，与ALS的延髓/假性延髓受累及额颞叶痴呆谱系相关，具有鉴别诊断和预判性管理的转化价值。

items.title: The accessory makes the drug: ASO-delivered siRNA enters the human CNS for ALS.
items.summary: In a recent article in Nature Medicine, Chen et al. describe a first-in-human study using an ASO tag to deliver a SOD1 siRNA to the central nervous system (CNS), potentially achieving faster, more extensive, and better-tolerated SOD1-lowering in ALS patients. 1 .

items.titleZh: 辅件成就药物：ASO递送的siRNA进入人中枢神经系统用于ALS治疗
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇针对Chen等人在《自然·医学》发表的首次人体研究的评论/解读文章。该研究利用ASO作为递送标签，将SOD1 siRNA导入中枢神经系统，旨在实现更快、更广泛且耐受性更好的SOD1蛋白下调。文章强调这种“辅件”（ASO标签）对siRNA药物递送的关键作用，提示该策略可能为SOD1-ALS患者提供新的治疗路径。
items.insight: 该研究首次在人体中验证了ASO标签递送siRNA至中枢神经系统的可行性，为ALS的RNA靶向治疗提供了新的递送范式。若该策略能实现更广泛的中枢神经系统分布和更好的耐受性，将可能突破现有ASO药物在递送效率和安全性上的局限，值得关注其后续临床数据。

items.title: A genetic screen for suppressors of neuron degeneration in a C. elegans sod-1G85R model of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Genetic variants in superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) cause the progressive neurodegenerative disease Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS). Treatments for this disease are limited, and the unique vulnerability of cholinergic and glutamatergic motor neurons to degeneration seen in ALS patients is not clearly understood. Identifying genetic modifiers of neurodegeneration can provide insight into the selective vulnerability of motor neurons in ALS and may accelerate identification of novel therapeutic targets. Here, we describe a forward genetic screen for suppressors of the stress-induced glutamatergic neuron degeneration in a single-copy C. elegans model of sod-1G85R. Used two different screening strategies, we identified 53 suppressor lines that decreased glutamatergic neuron degeneration to varying degrees. To rapidly identify suppressor genes, we sequenced suppressor lines and identified candidate suppressor genes based on frequency of de novo exonic mutations and previously published work. Two candidates were tested and excluded as suppressor genes: erh-1 and imph-1. For a subset of unidentified suppressor lines, we determined if cholinergic neurodegeneration was also suppressed; roughly one-third of suppressor lines showed no corresponding cholinergic neuron rescue, suggesting that mechanisms involved in cholinergic and glutamatergic degeneration are at least partially divergent. This study outlines the first unbiased genetic screen in a knock-in model of SOD1 neurodegeneration, describes a cohort of candidate suppressor lines with decreased SOD1-dependent neurodegeneration, excludes two candidates and discusses approaches for suppressor mutation isolation and gene identification.

items.abstractZh: 超氧化物歧化酶1（SOD1）的遗传变异导致进行性神经退行性疾病肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）。该疾病的治疗手段有限，且ALS患者中胆碱能和谷氨酸能运动神经元对变性的独特易感性尚不明确。鉴定神经退行性变的遗传修饰因子有助于理解ALS中运动神经元的选择性易感性，并可能加速新型治疗靶点的发现。在此，我们描述了一项在单拷贝秀丽隐杆线虫sod-1G85R模型中针对应激诱导的谷氨酸能神经元变性抑制因子的正向遗传筛选。采用两种不同的筛选策略，我们鉴定出53个抑制因子品系，这些品系不同程度地减轻了谷氨酸能神经元变性。为快速鉴定抑制因子基因，我们对抑制因子品系进行了测序，并基于新发外显子突变的频率和既往发表的工作鉴定候选抑制因子基因。两个候选基因被测试并排除为抑制因子基因：erh-1和imph-1。对于一部分未鉴定的抑制因子品系，我们确定了胆碱能神经退行性变是否也被抑制；大约三分之一的抑制因子品系未显示相应的胆碱能神经元挽救，提示参与胆碱能和谷氨酸能变性的机制至少部分不同。本研究概述了在SOD1神经退行性变敲入模型中的首个无偏遗传筛选，描述了一组减轻SOD1依赖性神经退行性变的候选抑制因子品系，排除了两个候选基因，并讨论了抑制因子突变分离和基因鉴定的方法。

items.title: Proteostasis (in)action: the role of co-pathologies in neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Clinically distinct neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), share in common progressive neuronal dysfunction and cell death associated with the accumulation of misfolded proteins. Central to these processes are the cellular and organismal proteostasis networks responsible for maintaining protein homeostasis through coordinated actions of molecular chaperones, the ubiquitin-proteasome system and autophagy-lysosomal pathways. As a consequence of ageing, genetic modifications and other disease-specific conditions, the proteostatic network becomes compromised, leading to the accumulation of toxic protein aggregates that disrupt neuronal function and lead to neurodegeneration. Specific misfolded proteins are associated with each neurodegenerative disease (i.e. α-synuclein in PD, amyloid-β/tau in AD and TAR DNA-binding protein 43/SOD in ALS). However, increasing evidence implicates more complex interactions of co-pathologies across these disorders, as Lewy bodies are common in AD brains and Alzheimer pathology is present in the majority of PD autopsy cases. These observations are consistent with the idea that disruption of proteostasis networks by one aggregation-prone protein could result in misfolding and aggregation of other neurodegeneration-related species. This review will examine the characteristics and consequences of co-pathologies in neurodegenerative disorders. Additionally, the review will outline emerging therapeutic strategies targeted at restoring proteostasis and mitigating the effects of co-pathological processes associated with neurodegenerative diseases. This article is part of the Theo Murphy meeting issue 'ProteostaSys: a systems view of proteostasis'.
items.titleZh: 蛋白质稳态的（失）衡：共病病理在神经退行性疾病中的作用
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述指出，AD、PD和ALS等神经退行性疾病虽然各有特征性的错误折叠蛋白，但共病病理现象十分普遍，例如AD脑内常见路易小体、多数PD尸检病例存在AD病理。作者认为，一种聚集倾向蛋白破坏蛋白质稳态网络后，可能引发其他神经退行相关蛋白的错误折叠和聚集，形成恶性循环。综述还梳理了以恢复蛋白质稳态为目标的治疗策略。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS置于更广泛的神经退行性疾病共病框架中，提示ALS的TDP-43或SOD病理可能并非孤立事件，而是蛋白质稳态网络崩溃的一部分。对ALS研究者而言，这为理解ALS与其他神经退行性疾病的共同机制、以及开发靶向蛋白质稳态的广谱干预策略提供了理论依据。

items.abstractZh: 临床上各具特征的神经退行性疾病，包括阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS），共同具有与错误折叠蛋白积累相关的进行性神经元功能障碍和细胞死亡。这些过程的核心是细胞和机体层面的蛋白质稳态网络，该网络通过分子伴侣、泛素-蛋白酶体系统和自噬-溶酶体途径的协调作用维持蛋白质稳态。由于衰老、遗传改变和其他疾病特异性条件，蛋白质稳态网络受损，导致毒性蛋白聚集体积累，破坏神经元功能并导致神经退行性变。每种神经退行性疾病都与特定的错误折叠蛋白相关（即PD中的α-突触核蛋白、AD中的淀粉样蛋白-β/tau以及ALS中的TAR DNA结合蛋白43/SOD）。然而，越来越多的证据表明这些疾病之间存在更复杂的共病病理相互作用，因为路易小体在AD大脑中常见，而阿尔茨海默病理存在于大多数PD尸检病例中。这些观察结果与以下观点一致：一种易于聚集的蛋白质对蛋白质稳态网络的破坏可能导致其他神经退行性相关蛋白种类的错误折叠和聚集。本综述将探讨神经退行性疾病中共病病理的特征和后果。此外，本综述将概述旨在恢复蛋白质稳态和减轻与神经退行性疾病相关的共病病理过程影响的新兴治疗策略。本文是Theo Murphy会议议题“ProteostaSys：蛋白质稳态的系统观”的一部分。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，系统整合了神经退行性疾病中共病病理与蛋白质稳态失衡的新近证据，并探讨了恢复蛋白质稳态的治疗策略，对ALS及其他神经退行性疾病的转化研究具有参考价值。

items.title: Anesthetic Management and Perioperative Outcome of Emergency Laparotomy in a Patient With Advanced Motor Neurone Disease: A Case Report.
items.summary: Motor neurone disease (MND) presents significant perioperative challenges due to progressive respiratory muscle weakness, bulbar dysfunction, autonomic instability, and altered sensitivity to anesthetic agents. Emergency surgery further limits opportunities for optimisation and advance planning. We report the perioperative and anesthetic management of a patient with advanced MND undergoing emergency laparotomy for small bowel obstruction. A total intravenous anesthetic with cautious use of neuromuscular blockade was employed, and the patient was successfully extubated postoperatively. Despite an initially uncomplicated postoperative course, the patient subsequently developed progressive respiratory failure in the context of ongoing intra-abdominal pathology. Following multidisciplinary discussion and shared decision-making, care was transitioned to a comfort-focused approach. This case highlights the limitations of perioperative intervention in advanced MND and emphasizes the importance of goal-concordant care in emergency surgical settings.

items.title: Near-optimal P300 speller performance using large language models: A multi-model analysis with performance bounds.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a progressive neurodegenerative disease, severely impairs communication, requiring assistive technologies that restore interaction. The P300 speller brain-computer interface (BCI) enables communication by translating EEG responses into text; however, its practical adoption is limited by slow typing speed and the need for subject-specific calibration. Recent work has demonstrated that large language models (LLMs), such as GPT-2, can significantly improve the performance of the P300 speller by predicting words. However, it remains unclear whether these gains are model-specific or represent a broader trend across language models. Furthermore, the framework-specific performance bounds of LLM-assisted P300 spellers have not been systematically characterized within a unified decoding framework. In this study, we address these gaps through a systematic multi-model theoretical analysis framework. We evaluate a wide range of language models and introduce an idealized LLM to establish upper bounds on achievable performance. In addition, we incorporate cross-subject classifier training to reduce calibration requirements and assess generalization across subjects. Using extensive simulations on EEG data from 78 subjects, we demonstrate that the evaluated models consistently achieve substantial improvements in typing speed, with gains of up to ~45% (within-subject training) and ~75% (across-subject training) over conventional approaches. More importantly, we show that several high-performing models, despite architectural differences, operate within 5% of the theoretical performance bound, indicating diminishing returns from further model scaling. These improvements generalize across both within-subject and across-subject classifiers. Our results suggest that LLM-assisted P300 spellers are approaching oracle-based upper bounds within the considered decoding framework, shifting the primary bottleneck from language modeling to neural signal decoding. This work provides both a practical framework for improving BCI communication and a theoretical perspective on its achievable limits.
